import asyncio


async def run(groups):
    for batch in groups:
        async def save_one(item):
            await save(item)
            await audit(item)
        await asyncio.gather(*(save_one(item) for item in batch))
    for batch in groups:
        try:
            await asyncio.gather(*(save(item) for item in batch))
        except Exception as error:
            log(error)
